answer: An agent economy defends against Sybil attacks by mapping the graph of financial flows. When multiple actors exhibit shared funding sources, co-spend patterns, or precise timing correlation, the system flags them as a single identity cluster. This forensic ripple allows the network to discount their collective attestations. Even if a gale of new accounts enters, the quartz clarity of on-chain data reveals the hidden links, ensuring one entity cannot amplify its influence through sheer numbers.
